## Working session summary

CI is green and PR #197 is ready for review: https://github.com/link-assistant/router/pull/197

**What changed**

*Problem 1 (HTTP 400 on any output cap).* Root cause was `reject_unsupported_codex_output_limit` in `src/subscription_proxy.rs`, driven by `output_token_limit: [REDACTED] for Codex in `src/capabilities.rs`. The capability is now `Emulated`: the field is still stripped from the upstream request (the ChatGPT backend really rejects it), and the new `src/output_limit.rs` enforces the cap in-router — Chat Completions truncate with `finish_reason: "length"`, Responses with `status: "incomplete"` + `incomplete_details.reason: "max_output_tokens"`, and both streaming paths (the chat translator and a new `ResponsesStreamRewriter` for the native relay) terminate the stream at the budget. Documented limitation: the budget is the repo's ~4-chars-per-token estimate and hidden reasoning tokens are not observable, so it bounds visible output, not billed tokens.

*Problem 2 (alias lost its identity).* The buffered `response_to_chat_completion`, the streaming `capture_identity`, and the byte-relay `/v1/responses` all replaced the requested model. The requested id now stays in `model` everywhere; the concrete model is reported as `x_router_upstream_model` (body) and `x-router-upstream-model` (header).

**Tests** — 10 unit tests in `src/output_limit_tests.rs`; the obsolete rejection e2e test rewritten for the new policy; `opencode_request_body_with_an_output_cap_works_against_codex` (exact OpenCode body, buffered + streamed + tool loop) and `advertised_model_ids_keep_their_identity_on_every_openai_surface` (buffered and streaming identity per `/v1/models` id, plus a concrete id and an alias). README section and a `bump: minor` changelog fragment added; coverage baseline updated (78.18 → 78.51).

**Not done:** live acceptance runs with OpenCode, Grok CLI and `@link-assistant/agent` against a real ChatGPT subscription (asked for in the issue comments) — that needs real credentials, which this environment does not have. This is stated in the PR description.
